overview.Module Title: Emotional Intelligence and Communication for Managers

sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module focuses on the emotional intelligence skills needed to be a successful manager. The module adopts a workshop style of teaching and will involve many practical exercises to gain insights and practice in identifying and using emotional intelligence skills.
sections.Learning outcomes: A Identify the relevance of emotional intelligence for management and leadership roles, including teamwork and interpersonal communication B Understand the nature of emotions and the different components of emotional intelligence C Reflect on their current level of emotional intelligence and emotional skills and its impact on current performance D Identify ways to develop emotional intelligence and emotional skills for future performance
sections.Method of teaching and learning: Lecture Case study Class discussion Simulation and role-play
